Verified disjoint three independent ways, 2026-09-05. (1) Row sets: M040 (block 0111) writes lifecycle_state only through vendor_capability_suspensions WHERE provider_name = openregister; M055 (block 0112) writes only the eight PR #518 free-public-API slugs, whose upstreams are OpenAlex, arXiv, NCBI, Algolia HN, SEC EDGAR, NIST NVD and USGS. Checked against production: 0 rows in vendor_capability_suspensions and 0 in vendor_capability_dependencies touch any of the eight. (2) Interlock: M055 requires deactivation_reason IS NULL, and M040 sets deactivation_reason to its suspension marker whenever it suspends, so M055 can never reverse a vendor suspension even if the sets did meet. (3) Ledger guard: M055 fires exactly once ever (startup_migration_ledger), so it cannot ping-pong with anything across boots, which is the 2026-08-21 incident shape this check exists for. M040 runs before M055 within a boot, so ordering does not hide a conflict either.
